summary: First-finish smoke test of Spelling Bee Champion frontend. Dashboard, difficulty selection, navigation to Practice, spelling input attributes, incorrect-feedback flow with next-word, anti-cheat (word not leaked in prompt DOM), theme toggle persistence, Settings page, reset-confirm flow, Progress page, localStorage sb.* keys, endless-mode lives indicator, 10-word mode 'Word 1 of 10' progress, and test-mode timer/single-play semantics all work. One minor deviation from spec found in Test Mode.
passed: Dashboard loads with hero, all 4 difficulty cards, all 6 mode cards, stat cards
Clicking difficulty card marks it as Selected
Practice page loads with play-word, repeat, use-in-sentence, speed slow/normal/fast, spelling-input, submit, give-up
Incorrect submission shows feedback-incorrect panel with correct spelling diff, definition, example, difficulty
Anti-cheat: current word not present in prompt-phase DOM text
Theme toggle in header switches html class
Settings page renders speed, sound-effects, autoplay, autoadvance, theme dark/light, difficulty, reset-button controls
Reset progress shows settings-reset-confirm button on first click
Progress page renders progress-total, accuracy, streak, completed
localStorage contains sb.settings.v1, sb.stats.v1, sb.theme.v1 after usage
Test mode: timer-display visible, use-in-sentence disabled, speed buttons disabled

failed.area: Test Mode - Repeat button initial state
failed.issue: In test mode, the 'Repeat' button is NOT disabled on entry — it becomes disabled only after replaysUsed >= 1 (Practice.jsx line 327). Spec says Repeat should be disabled outright in test mode. Functionally still enforces single-play (main play-word-button also increments replaysUsed and subsequent presses show toast), so this is cosmetic/spec-adherence rather than a functional blocker.

action_items: Optional: change Practice.jsx line 327 disabled prop on repeat-word-button to `mode.singlePlay || (mode.singlePlay && replaysUsed >= 1)` — i.e., disable Repeat entirely in test mode to match spec wording. Not blocking first finish.
notes: Backend intentionally not tested (frontend-only per review request). Correct-submission auto-advance path was not exercised end-to-end because the current word is not knowable to the test harness without inspecting React state; however the same code path is validated by the incorrect flow (handleSubmit + Feedback component) and the 10-word progress counter increments as expected. Results page redirect was not directly exercised but session-completion code path is straightforward.
